description: Ministry of Health - Food Act, No 26 of 1980, the Food (Trans - Fast) Regulation 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980, specifically amending the Food (Trans-Fat) Regulations. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, legal amendments, and statutory instruments related to food safety regulations. While it mentions the Minister of Health by name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, so it does not qualify for Types 1-3.
